HR Officer Job at Swift Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Swift Consulting Limited is a professional services firm specializing in Education Consulting, Human Resource Management, and Management Consulting. We connect top talent with leading organizations across industries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Officer 

Job Location: Abuloma - Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive and experienced Human Resources Officer to manage key HR functions, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, policy implementation, and compliance.
	The ideal candidate will support the organization's people strategy while fostering a positive and productive work environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage end-to-end recruitment and onboarding processes.
	Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
	Implement HR policies and ensure compliance with labour regulations.
	Handle employee relations, disciplinary matters, and grievance resolution.
	Coordinate performance management and staff development initiatives.
	Process leave administration and support payroll-related HR activities.
	Prepare HR reports and provide administrative support to management.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 4 years of experience in a Human Resources role.
	Professional HR certification (CIPM, SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent) is an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian labour laws and HR best practices.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR software is an advantage.
	Male candidates are encouraged to apply to support gender balance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "HR Officer" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Logistics Lead Job at Pinnacle Pinnacle Oil and Gas Limited




        
    

        
        Pinnacle Oil and Gas Limited is an Indigenous Oil and Gas Company active across the entire downstream value chain, with emphasis on the petroleum trading, marketing, distribution and retail segments of the Nigerian Oil and Gas Sector.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Logistics Lead
Job Location: Free Zone, Ibeju – Lekki
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: General Manager 

Job Description
     

            
    




	Maximize truck utilization through effective planning and scheduling.
	Optimize truck deployment to reduce fuel consumption and operating costs.
	Ensure the assigned fleet achieves the minimum monthly trip targets
	Work closely with the Sales team and third-party customers to secure additional haulage opportunities that improve fleet utilization.
	Ensure timely and reliable delivery of products for local, inter-district and bridging operations.
	Coordinate truck mobilization to meet loading schedules and customer requirements.
	Monitor delivery performance and proactively resolve issues affecting service delivery.


Requirements


	HND or Bsc in Business Administration, Transport management or a related field is an added advantage.
	Minimum of 3 - 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in Haulage, Logistics Operations or Fleet Management as a Logistics Lead or Supervisor.
	Relevant administrative certification is an advantage.
	Team-oriented with good reporting discipline.
	Proximity to Ibeju Lekki is an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] with the Job Position as the subject of the email.    

    

        Click here to Apply

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Store / Procurement Officer",
  "description": "African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 52 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nigeria&rsquo;s socio-economic growth and industrial development and is equally committed to the nurturing and development of the local community.
AIG owes its success to the core philosophy of &lsquo;Building the Future Together&rsquo;. Its business strategy is inclusive, sustainable, and not only benefits stakeholders but also positively impacts the environment and society.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Store / Procurement Officer&nbsp;

Job Location: Ikorodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Manage the receipt, storage, and issuance of materials and supplies.
	Maintain accurate inventory and stock records.
	Monitor stock levels and support timely replenishment.
	Source and procure materials, goods, and services as required.
	Obtain and compare quotations from suppliers.
	Liaise with vendors and internal departments to ensure timely delivery of materials.
